title: FRAs and interest-rate swaps as dated cash flows
objectives: Replicate advance-settled and end-settled FRAs with correct signs and dates
Derive par swap rates, off-market values, and discount-factor bootstraps
Value a floating bond between resets and reconcile swap bond/coupon-strip methods
Identify projection, discounting, overnight observation, and comparative-funding limitations
prerequisites: Chapter 1 swap cash-flow definitions; Chapter 8 discount factors, zero and forward rates; Chapters 11 and 21 historical benchmark boundaries; dated present-value calculations.
source_scope: Full official English captions at positions 55–57 read sequentially, all source examples independently recomputed. No comprehensive audiovisual audit. Forward-realization assumptions, FRA settlement timing, contractual reset rights, day counts, and single-curve shortcuts are explicitly qualified.
